Hi Dylan,

We are wrapping up our SIG/CAIQ and CAIQ submission and your penetration test report is listed as a required artifact under the ‘Offensive Security’ section. Can you confirm how we should receive: (1) the full pen test report for our security team (redacted as needed), and (2) the evidence index that maps findings to remediation tickets? Our procurement team needs the files uploaded into the BrightBridge GRC portal URL below — with metadata fields populated (report date, scope, redaction level).

GRC Portal upload link: https://grc.brightbridge.com/upload/RED-12345

Constraints from our side: we cannot accept documents that contain unredacted IP ranges or internal employee contact details. We also need an explicit statement of remediation status for high/critical findings.

Can you send an ETA and confirm whether the report will be a redacted PDF plus an evidence spreadsheet, or if you require a different exchange mechanism?

Thanks — Sam

Quick clarifications so we upload correctly:
- Redaction: we will remove internal hostnames, internal-only IP ranges, and direct contact emails by default. If BrightBridge needs specific IP ranges preserved for validation, please list them explicitly.
- Signature/authorization: we need BrightBridge to confirm the redaction level in writing (email reply or the MOU upload below) before we post the report to your portal.
- Delivery mechanism: preferred is direct upload to your GRC portal (we can deliver via SFTP if your portal requires it). We will also attach an evidence_index_BB_20261112.xlsx as the manifest.

ETA: we can prepare redacted report and evidence index by EOD Thu 2026-11-12 PT if you confirm the redaction consent. If you need an earlier time for critical items only, we can push a high/critical findings summary tomorrow morning.

I’m looping in Sean from Product Security for the redaction checklist and Evelyn from Customer Success for the GRC metadata fields.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks

Sam / Dylan — a few technical notes from Product Security before we upload:

Redaction checklist (we will apply):
- Remove full internal IP ranges (RFC1918) and any internal routable addresses.
- Obfuscate hostnames that reveal internal naming conventions.
- Strip developer PII (personal work emails and phone numbers) unless explicitly required.
- Replace exact proof-of-concept snippets that contain customer-specific tokens with sanitized examples.

Evidence index template we will provide includes columns: Finding ID | Severity | CVE (if applicable) | Affected component | Remediation ticket ID | Patch/PR link | Verified-by (engineer) | Verification date | Status (fixed/in-progress/won't-fix)

We will also include a one-page remediation summary table that you can paste into the SIG response. If BrightBridge needs signed confirmation of redaction (for audit trail), we can add a short MOU PDF stating the redaction level — please confirm.

Operational note: if you need the original unredacted report for internal audit, we can provide it under an NDA/SFTP share to a named contact. Otherwise we will only upload the redacted copy to your portal.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Product Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
